title: Ulyana and the Letter
premise: In 1913, apprentice clockmaker Hazel Montrose is summoned to repair the observatory's master clock and discovers the town's requisition ledger hidden in its case — a list of every resident slated for evacuation when the army seizes the coast. As the deadline approaches, Hazel must decide which of her estranged family members gets the single remaining berth, while her growing bond with Ulyana, a displaced clerk who keeps the ledger, forces her to weigh loyalty against truth. In the end, Hazel forges an extra entry to save them both, exposing the ledger's corruption at the cost of her apprenticeship, and the two leave together as the master clock strikes its final, deliberately unsynchronized hour.
about_author: Oscar Ravensworth is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing requisition records from coastal towns. His fiction blends mechanical precision with quiet human defiance.

chapters.title: The Weight of Small Gears
chapters.summary: Hazel arrives at the observatory to repair the master clock, measuring her worth in tools carried. POV: Hazel. Beat: cautious ambition shadowed by her family's cold distance.

chapters.title: A Ledger in the Case
chapters.summary: Behind the clock's faceplate Hazel finds a sealed ledger of names. POV: Hazel. Beat: unease — some mechanisms are built to hide things.

chapters.title: Ulyana
chapters.summary: Ulyana, the army's displaced clerk, catches Hazel with the ledger but says nothing. POV: Ulyana. Beat: wary recognition between two people keeping secrets.

chapters.title: Orders Come Down
chapters.summary: The army formally requisitions the town; notices nail to doors overnight. POV: Hazel. Beat: dread hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Names in Ink
chapters.summary: Hazel reads the ledger fully: her mother listed, her brother omitted, herself unranked. POV: Hazel. Beat: betrayal by paperwork.

chapters.title: The Clerk's Confession
chapters.summary: Ulyana admits she copied the ledger before it was seized and fears what the missing pages contain. POV: Ulyana. Beat: guilt seeking an ally.

chapters.title: Brother at the Harbor
chapters.summary: Hazel finds Tomas working the docks, unaware he has no berth. POV: Hazel. Beat: love tangled with old resentment.

chapters.title: One Berth
chapters.summary: Hazel learns only one berth remains for her family line. POV: Hazel. Beat: the impossible arithmetic begins.

chapters.title: What Mother Kept
chapters.summary: Her mother reveals why she left the observatory years ago — and that she knew about the ledger. POV: Hazel. Beat: sympathy cracking open old wounds.

chapters.title: Inspection
chapters.summary: An army officer audits the clock and nearly discovers the ledger's hiding place. POV: Ulyana. Beat: terror sharpening trust between the women.

chapters.title: Tomas's Bargain
chapters.summary: Tomas offers to give his berth claim to their mother if Hazel will finally speak to him honestly. POV: Tomas via Hazel. Beat: forgiveness offered too easily to accept.

chapters.title: The Missing Pages
chapters.summary: Ulyana deciphers the torn pages: names were sold to the highest bidders. POV: Ulyana. Beat: righteous fury.

chapters.title: Midnight Repair
chapters.summary: Working through the night on the master clock, Hazel and Ulyana grow close over gears and confessions. POV: Hazel. Beat: tenderness amid countdown.

chapters.title: Mother Refuses
chapters.summary: Her mother declines the berth, insisting it go to Tomas — or to Hazel herself. POV: Hazel. Beat: sacrifice met with anger, not gratitude.

chapters.title: The Officer's Offer
chapters.summary: The officer offers Hazel a berth in exchange for the copied pages. POV: Ulyana. Beat: temptation wearing a uniform.

chapters.title: Ulyana's Choice
chapters.summary: Ulyana burns her own name from the copy so no one can trade it. POV: Ulyana. Beat: self-erasure as loyalty.

chapters.title: Forged Entry
chapters.summary: Hazel uses her clockmaker's skill to forge a second berth entry, sealing it inside the clock mechanism. POV: Hazel. Beat: treason committed with a steady hand.

chapters.title: Discovery
chapters.summary: The audit finds the forgery; Hazel is detained and the clock impounded. POV: Hazel. Beat: the cost arrives all at once.

chapters.title: The Master Clock Speaks
chapters.summary: At the public hearing, the master clock — rigged by Hazel — strikes out of sync, halting proceedings while Ulyana presents the sold-names evidence. POV: Ulyana. Beat: climax; machines become testimony.

chapters.title: Fallout
chapters.summary: The officer is disgraced; Hazel loses her apprenticeship but gains her freedom. Her mother and Tomas reconcile over her. POV: Hazel. Beat: grief and relief entwined.

chapters.title: Last Train from the Coast
chapters.summary: Hazel and Ulyana board the final evacuation train together, carrying only what fits in a toolbox. POV: Hazel. Beat: belonging found in a person, not a place.

chapters.title: An Unsynchronized Hour
chapters.summary: Years later, Hazel keeps a small clock that runs deliberately off-time, a private monument to the hour everything changed. POV: Hazel. Beat: resolution — time measured now in what was chosen, not lost.
